reason: Simpler than ClickUp sounds nice, but half my work involves clients and contractors, and nothing here says they can get in without a paid seat. I'd maybe poke at the trial, but I'm not moving my team for another tool that only works for the people on payroll.
objection: Per-seat pricing with no mention of free guest access. If every client and freelancer needs a $15 seat, the real bill isn't $45, it's whatever my contractor count is that month, and I left ClickUp partly to stop that kind of thing.
would_change_my_mind: Free guest or client access to their own client page and tasks, stated plainly up front.
